summary: Ep 83 promoted from graft-annotation to an exact record. Hunterpedia's page-level infobox gives 194 p.6-7, 10-15 + 195 + 196 + 288 p.9-10, and animefillerguide's chapter table independently lists 194, 195, 196, 288 for the episode; chapter reverse maps agree (194 -> eps 82+83; 195, 196 -> ep 83 only). The ch 288 fragment is the flash-forward: Netero's phone call with the world leaders ordering the Ants' extermination, which in the manga appears only as a flashback during the palace invasion (ch 288, adapted linearly in eps 121-122) — both Hunterpedia's and Wikipedia's episode summaries open with that scene, so it leads the in-order list. END=196 (the 288 sliver does not advance END), start=195 by majority rule (the 194 fragments are an 8-page tail), volume 19, continue = 197 = end+1 so no continue point needed.

anchors.note: Opens with the ch 288 p.9-10 flash-forward (Netero ordered by the world leaders to exterminate the Ants; in the manga this is a flashback during Netero vs Meruem), then linear material: ch 194 tail fragments (Chimera Ant hierarchy exposition, Hagya's squadron closing in), ch 195 (Rammot/Colt Nen discovery; Frog's one-on-one terms; Gon vs Baro) and ch 196 (Killua vs Rhino, Kite's Crazy Slots scythe massacre). START=195 by majority rule; END=196 with the 288 sliver recorded but not advancing END. MAL thread manga-readers confirm fight-scene fidelity (Killua's fight expanded from near-offscreen manga treatment) without disputing the chapter set.

annotation_updates.note: page-level refinement of the stored {288} graft annotation: exactly ch 288 p.9-10 (Netero's phone call with the world leaders), a flash-forward of material whose linear adaptation is eps 121-122; ch 288's reverse map accordingly lists only eps 121-122

flags_for_sean: independence caveat (mild): animefillerguide's row matches Hunterpedia's chapter set exactly and may share lineage; the genuinely independent checks are Wikipedia's episode summary (leads with the Hunter Association / extermination-order scene and matches the 194-196 fight content) and the chapter-side reverse maps. No source disputes any value.
